title: Photo stack
description: Three to five photo cards fly in one by one and settle into a fanned stack (Motion springs with bounce); the last one lands on top, the largest. The stack takes most of the frame and the title stands beside it. Put a photo of a person last so no card covers it.

props.items: required, 3-5 of {src, alt, face} (or plain paths): pictures; the last one lands on top. face is [x, y, w, h] when a picture shows a person (put that one last)
props.title: heading beside the stack

items.alt: Stand-in picture: a road on a map
